_comment: Declared non-session rows for the P&L history audit (executor/pnl_integrity.py check_session_axis_coverage and check_benchmark_vendor_anchor). Each entry excuses ONE persisted eod_pnl row on a date the NYSE calendar says was never a session; the row itself is never edited. An entry needs a ruling id, and a date that really is a non-session row of the series, or it is its own breach. The set is closed: eod_reconcile refuses a non-session run_date since crucible-executor PR531, so this list can only shrink.

declarations.reason: Good Friday. A live EOD run marked the book against IB holiday quotes (alpha-engine-config-I9615), so the row carries +2.16bp of alpha from a day the market never opened; the vendor has no session. The ruled restatement refuses this session and leaves the row as stored; no edit or delete was authorised.
